author: Inside Edition
description: A witness recalls watching a woman fall to her death through an open manhole on a New York City street. Carlton Wood tells WCBS he and others rushed to help the woman. The FDNY was able to get her out and rushed her to a hospital. Donika Gocaj, 56, was later pronounced dead. The manhole was managed by New York City's electric supplier, Con Edison. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Woman Falls To Death Through Open NYC Manhole

author: Inside Edition
description: Are some tanning beds always cleaned between guests? Most health departments require tanning beds to be cleaned between uses. Ann Mercogliano puts tanning salons to the test using a special, non-toxic glow gel that easily washes off when wiped with a wet cloth or disinfectant spray. INSIDE EDITION went to seven tanning salons to investigate.
title: How Clean Are Some Tanning Beds? We Put Them To The Test.

author: Inside Edition
description: INSIDE EDITION's new investigative reporter, Matt Johnson, put some New Jersey locksmiths to the test using a home rigged with hidden cameras. First, two certified master locksmiths showed how us how easy it was to pick-open the locked front door in seconds without causing any damage. Then we relocked the door and called for help. So why did one locksmith take a drill to our front door?
title: How Reliable Are Locksmiths That Show Up At Your Door? We Put Them To The Test.

author: Inside Edition
description: Melanie Smith listed an old iPhone on Facebook Marketplace and what followed, she says, was three years of stalking.
title: Woman Says Man Has Been Harassing Her For Years After Facebook Marketplace Listing #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Food surprises are usually found in cracker jacks or cereal, not in bags of salad, but four roommates in Australia say their bag of lettuce came with a little green tree frog. One of the roomies noticed it while he was cooking. The friends gave him a name, Greg, but they weren't quite ready to take on a fifth roommate, so they say they gave him a warm sendoff. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Little Green Tree Frog Found In Bag Of Lettuce Purchased At Grocery Store
